lessonsNeverToRepeat: Do not launch liquidity before public token identity/metadata/indexer readiness is verified.
Do not treat repository CI or HTTP 200 as proof that the real mobile wallet flow works.
Do not require the user to paste a Worldz URL into a wallet browser.
Do not publish malformed or hard-to-copy action links.
Do not infer a live Squads proposal from a page existing.
Do not silently replace recipient wallets, token mints, fee destinations or owner-approved allocations.
Do not collapse setup, distribution, liquidity, vesting, rent recovery and verification into one status.
Do not fabricate DevCity, legacy-holder, charity, team or giveaway recipients.
Do not label wrapped/bridged BTC as native BTC.
Do not enable mainnet execution for a chain merely because another chain passed.
